variables.label: Temperature at 2 m
variables.description: Annual mean air temperature two metres above the surface. Use for warming, heat, and cooling questions at a place.
variables.keywords: temperature temp warming warmed warm heat hot cold climate air degrees

variables.label: Precipitation (corrected)
variables.description: Annual mean precipitation rate. Use for rain, rainfall, drying, drought, and wetting questions at a place.
variables.keywords: rain rainfall raining precipitation dry drier drying drought wet wetter monsoon storm water

variables.label: Root-zone soil wetness
variables.baseline: absolute wetness, fraction of pore space filled (0 = dry, 1 = saturated)
variables.description: Annual mean root-zone soil wetness: the share of the soil's pore space holding water, 0 (dry) to 1 (saturated), over roughly the top metre. Use for soil moisture, agricultural drought, and land drying questions.
variables.keywords: soil moisture wetness saturation drought agriculture land dryness dry drier declining groundwater root zone

variables.label: Surface solar irradiance
variables.description: Annual mean all-sky downward shortwave radiation at the surface. Use for sunlight, solar, cloudiness, and radiation questions.
variables.keywords: solar sunlight radiation sunshine irradiance cloud cloudiness energy bright brighter dimmer

variables.label: Surface temperature anomaly
variables.description: Global gridded surface temperature anomaly. Use for global, regional, continent, and map-scale warming questions with a 1951–1980 baseline.
variables.keywords: global planet world earth map region continent temperature warming warmed anomaly gistemp places
